summary: Generative novel view synthesis (NVS) employs a diffusion model to render a static or dynamic scene from a target camera view. Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues.
takeaways: Explicit warp methods complete a reprojection of the source with video diffusion models, and implicit methods encode the camera parameters or 3D cues.
Both add inference overhead, and the generated layout often drifts from the ground truth.
WaveView keeps the architecture and adds negligible overhead.
